surface_verification.justification: No browser or server surface exists for this change: it alters two Python verifier/reader code paths reached only from the F11 CLI. F0.5 is Advisory at small with no UI and no touches_io_boundary (all four diff-driven detectors recomputed False against the real diff). The CLI path IS driven end-to-end in the suite - test_f11_still_prints_a_report_when_an_entry_file_is_undecodable runs the real verify_iterate_finalization.py as a subprocess against a real seeded git repo - and the original defect was reproduced the same way before any fix was written (F11 exit 1, EMPTY stdout, traceback).
